official: 立川市行政手続条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会議案一覧

name: 所在不明の人への通知方法を変更
summary: 所在が分からない人への聴聞の通知は、これまでは市長などの事務所の掲示場に掲示して行っていました。この議案で、規則で定める方法で広く閲覧できる状態に置き、事務所の掲示場への掲示または事務所の電子計算機画面での閲覧を組み合わせる方法に変わります。
changes: 通知事項を不特定多数が閲覧できる状態に置き、事務所の掲示場への掲示または電子計算機画面での閲覧を行う
変更後の通知方法を、続行期日の通知や弁明の機会を設ける手続にも適用する
who: 所在が分からない不利益処分の対象者
所在が分からない聴聞の当事者や参加人
why: デジタル社会形成基本法などを改正する法律が公布されたためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Changes notification method for people whose whereabouts are unknown
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Tachikawa City Administrative Procedure Ordinance
en.summary: Until now, notices of hearings for people whose whereabouts are unknown have been given by posting them on notice boards at the offices of the mayor and other officials. Under this bill, the method will change: notices will be made widely available for viewing in a manner prescribed by rules, together with either posting them on notice boards at the offices or making them viewable on computer screens there.
changes: Make notice details available for viewing by the general public, and post them on office notice boards or make them viewable on office computer screens
Apply the new notification method to notices of continuation dates and to procedures that provide an opportunity to submit an explanation
who: People subject to adverse dispositions whose whereabouts are unknown
Parties to hearings and hearing participants whose whereabouts are unknown
en.why: The city says this is because a law amending the Basic Act on the Formation of a Digital Society and other laws was promulgated.
